transactions.time: Rate-independent incremental residual; no elapsed seconds or creep.
transactions.old_new: Committed sigma_n,e_n,pc_n fixed during an internal solve; K,G,flow and log-hardening coefficient evaluated at current endpoint.
transactions.trial: Repeated trials start from committed persistent fields; no accumulation across rejected/equilibrium guesses. gamma reset for each internal solve.
transactions.subdivision: Compose updates on actual accepted increment fractions. gamma in returned layout belongs to final internal step; do not sum or carry it as history. Raw full-step references remain distinct from partition replay.
transactions.failure: Complete parent rollback, including temporary incoming slots; partial progress is diagnostic only. This packet does not rerun compiled rollback.
transactions.zero_increment: For admissible committed state,gamma0 yields unchanged persistent fields; no hold evolution.
transactions.tangent: Nonlinear endpoint elasticity and complementarity; no global branch uniqueness/smoothness is proved.
transactions.events: No inferred preparation/reset or yield-event location is added.
